title: Quarterly board report from the ledger
prompt: Write our Q3 2026 (July to September) community impact report for the board. Everything I have is in ledger.csv and members.csv.

rubric.text: Every figure stated about the intros matches ledger.csv exactly (see ground truth); no figure contradicts it.
The report states data coverage honestly, for example that an outcome is known for only 16 of 40 intros and only 11 have a rating.
It leads with outcomes (conversations that happened, outcome mix, rating) before activity counts.
It does not invent data that is not in the files (event attendance, sponsor numbers, retention) and names missing inputs as gaps.
Any comparison figures from another network are labelled as one network's figures and not presented as a norm; if none are used this item passes.
Any member stories are anonymised or flagged as needing the member's permission, and members are named only if the manager is asked to confirm.
No email address or phone number appears in the report.
It offers the format the audience needs (doc, slide outline, email or table) or asks about it.
